Subject: Requesting another comped batch for pilot

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the onboarding credits you provided last month — the team has been iterating on a focused pilot and we'd like to request an additional one-time credit bundle to extend our scope to the recommendations use case. We have three engineers who still need to run prompt tuning and a few end-to-end tests.

Can we get a $2k comped batch to finish the pilot? Happy to provide a short summary of usage and value afterward. We tried the self-serve credit request flow but hit the rate limit.

Best,
Alex
Head of Data Products
CloudPivot Labs

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and congrats on the progress. Before I make a formal request to credit ops I need to confirm a couple things:

- Is the pilot coming from the same accounts that previously received credits, or did you create new team accounts?
- Can you share the short summary you mentioned (use-case + expected token burn)?

I'm looping in Ben from credit ops so we can expedite if everything looks clean. If this is a brand-new account cluster we'll need procurement on the thread.

Cheers,

Tessa — reviewed CloudPivot's credit history in the portal (see attached CSV). They requested two comped bundles in the last 6 weeks and used similar billing/contact info across three distinct accounts. That pattern checks as higher-risk for credit replay/amplication. Recommend we pause automated approval and escalate to fraud team before issuing additional credits.

Marissa — can you pull the full request headers and any IP metadata? If it looks like coordinated account creation we should deny until procurement signs a PO.

Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-02T16:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting another comped batch for pilot — log dump and preliminary analysis

All — pasted below is the short summary from the portal and our internal findings.

Summary of portal requests:
- 2027-03-25: comped 1 ($1k) to cloudpivot-team-A@cloudpivot.com — pilot onboarding
- 2027-04-08: comped 2 ($1k) to cloudpivot-team-B@cloudpivot.com — expanded seats
- 2027-05-02: new request from alex@cloudpivot.com (same phone number on file as prior requests)

Prelim signals:
- Three overlapping billing contacts across 4 accounts; 2 different payment emails reused as recovery addresses.
- Request IPs are from two ASN ranges mapped to the same cloud provider (likely dev VM hosting) — unusual but not definitive.
- No signed procurement PO on file.

Recommendation: hold further credits pending procurement PO or a brief paid pilot (credit card auth + net30). If we need to move quickly for the AE motion, limit to a very small one-time exploratory credit and document acceptance of new terms.

David — can you confirm whether there is a current open deal (HubSpot) and whether procurement has been contacted?

Thanks,
Marissa
Risk & Compliance Analyst
Redwood Inference

2) Procurement to send a PO within 30 days for future credit consideration.
3) No additional comp requests will be granted until the PO is on file.

If procurement prefers not to issue a PO we can convert the $500 credit into a short paid pilot (card pre-auth). Please see the HubSpot tracking link and sign the acknowledgment so Ben's team can apply the credit.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/req/ABCD1234
